title: Lymn4x's PvP Assist Texture Pack
description: PvP-friendly pack with short swords, highlighted ores, and improved visuals that is preferred by Lymn4x.
body: Upgrade your Minecraft experience with subtle but powerful visual changes that stand out without straying too far from the original style. this pack gives cobwebs a unique teal color for better visibility, adds a sleek black Elytra for a clean and modern look, and customizes critical hit particles to make every hit feel more satisfying. Shorter swords help clear up your screen, making gameplay smoother and less cluttered especially in fast-paced situations!
